name: MBRACE Form Intake — Audit + Market Report

nodes.name: Webhook: Site Lead
nodes.notes: Use this production URL as N8N_WEBHOOK_AUDIT and N8N_WEBHOOK_REPORT in Netlify (same URL is fine). The Switch node routes by form-name.

nodes.name: Append Audit Lead
nodes.notes: Columns: received_at, form_name, email, company, gbp_url, website, zip, primary_service, status, notes

parameters.subject: Your 60-second Google Maps audit is in the queue
parameters.html:
=

Got it — I have your Google Business Profile.

I'll record a private 60-second video of the gaps costing you HVAC jobs in the DMV and send it here.

GBP: {{$json.gbp_url}}

— Max / MBRACE Insight

parameters.subject: Your DMV HVAC Market Intelligence Report is being prepared
parameters.html:
=

Thanks {{$json.company}} — we're mapping LSA, GBP, review velocity, and competitors around ZIP {{$json.zip}}.

You'll get the PDF within 24 hours.

— Max / MBRACE Insight

parameters.subject: =New {{$json.form_name}} lead — {{$json.company || $json.email}}
parameters.html:
=

Form: {{$json.form_name}}

Email: {{$json.email}}

Company: {{$json.company}}

GBP: {{$json.gbp_url}}

Website: {{$json.website}}

ZIP: {{$json.zip}}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, queued: true, form: $json.form_name }) }}

meta.description: Receives audit + market-report form posts from the MBRACE site, validates GBP/email/ZIP, appends to the Leads sheet, emails the prospect, and notifies Max to record the Loom or build the PDF.
